answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments using eight language models of different sizes and observe that CON‑TEXT ORGANIZER consistently improves performance over six baselines on both AmbigDocs+ and ConflictQA+ ... The Aggregator component processes each group sequentially, generating responses and aggregating them with citations from the source contexts.
answer_1.outputs: Answers with citations, possibly multiple answers per question

answer_2.quote: We evaluate over five baselines ... D‑F1 as our primary metric as it captures the presence of the surface name, descriptor, and answer information, but we also report the performance of other metrics such as Entity Recall, Answer Recall, and EAR.

answer_4.quote: We hire five freelancers to evaluate a random 10% sample of AmbigDocs+, assessing whether (1) generated contexts are relevant to the question, (2) answers are accurate and present within the document, and (3) the corpus represents the expected variety of real‑world context relationships.
answer_4.guideline: Freelancers check relevance of contexts, correctness of answers, and coverage of relationship factors.
